title: Deliver Livestock to Fort Chartborough Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Livestock** delivered to **Fort Chartborough Factory** (industry id 5, near tile 65,206).

A likely supplier is **Fort Chartborough Farm** (industry id 7, near tile 45,201); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **620 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
